en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. The official Georgia–Czech Republic MLI-synthesised treaty text provides a 5 per cent source-State ceiling where the beneficial owner holds at least 25 per cent of the capital of the payer and a 10 per cent ceiling in the other treaty case. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise synthesis of the official English treaty text; the official text controls.

Article 11 — Interest. The official Georgia–Czech Republic MLI-synthesised treaty text provides a general 8 per cent source-State ceiling where the recipient is the beneficial owner, with residence-State-only taxation for qualifying government, political subdivision, local authority, central bank, wholly government-owned financial institution, government-guaranteed financing and qualifying credit sales of industrial, commercial or scientific equipment. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise synthesis of the official English treaty text; the official text controls.

Article 12 — Royalties. The official Georgia–Czech Republic MLI-synthesised treaty text provides residence-State-only taxation for copyright royalties relating to literary, artistic or scientific works other than computer programs, including films and broadcast media; a 5 per cent source-State ceiling for industrial, commercial or scientific equipment; and a 10 per cent ceiling for patents, trademarks, designs or models, plans, secret formulae or processes, computer programs and know-how, where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise synthesis of the official English treaty text; the official text controls.
